notes: Hy-Tek results printed 5/28/2013 at Bowdoin College, Brunswick, Maine; the sheet gives no meet date other than the print/header date 2013-05-28 ("2013 Freshmen Championships Entry - 5/28/2013"), used as the date. Freshmen meet. Schools are written as full names with the printed address tails (",Freeport, ME", ",Lisbon Falls", ",ME, ME") removed; "Lisbon" -> Lisbon High School, "Poland H. S." -> Poland High School, "GORHAM HIGH SCHOOL" -> Gorham High School. Hand-timed marks printed with trailing "h" (e.g. 13.9h) are written without the h. A leading "J" on some marks (e.g. J13.9h, J4-02.00, several marks) is a Hy-Tek flag whose meaning the sheet does not state; the J is dropped and the mark kept. Field marks ".00" dropped (4-05.00 -> 4-05; 6-00.50 -> 6-00.5). Places are as printed, ties share the printed place. Event points are printed per row but no team score table is printed, so team_rankings is empty. "Women/Men 800 Sprint Medley" are written as Girls/Boys "800 Sprint Medley Relay" with no athlete names (none printed). Girls 800 Sprint Medley: Scarborough High School printed with place "---" and mark X2:10.00 (exhibition); kept with place null and result 2:10.00. Boys Pole Vault: Cleaves, Robbie (Poland) NH, place null. Boys Discus: White, Isaac (Dirigo) FOUL, place null.
